mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipt (parking_log_id, mem_id, pay_method, amount, parking_fee, ev_charging_fee, pay_date) VALUES (#{parkingLogId}, #{memId}, #{payMethod}, #{amount}, #{parkingFee}, #{evChargingFee}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r JOIN member_vehicle v ON r.mem_id = v.mem_id WHERE v.vehicle_num = #{vehicleNum} AND r.reservation_status = '완료' AND r.reservation_date = CAST(TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') AS INTEGER)
